description: This file defines the interface for a simple inter-process communication (IPC) API, including enums for IPC states, client connection options, server initialization, and communication functions.
published: typedef int (ipc_server_reply_cb)(struct ipc_server_reply_data *, const char *, size_t)
typedef int (ipc_server_application_cb)(void *, const char *, size_t, ipc_server_reply_cb *, struct ipc_server_reply_data *)

methods.name: ipc_client_try_connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a server at a specified path with given options, returning the IPC active state and connection handle.

methods.name: ipc_client_send_command_to_connection
methods.description: Sends a command message over an existing connection and receives the response.

methods.name: ipc_client_send_command
methods.description: Connects to a server at a specified path, sends a command, and receives the response.

methods.name: ipc_server_init_async
methods.description: Initializes an asynchronous IPC server with specified options and callback.

methods.name: ipc_server_stop_async
methods.description: Signals the server to stop accepting new connections and finish existing ones.

methods.name: ipc_server_await
methods.description: Blocks until all server threads have completed.

methods.name: ipc_server_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the server.

methods.name: ipc_server_run
methods.description: Runs the IPC server synchronously, blocking until shutdown or error.
